notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.notes:
Corrected bug in which gumming did not turn right in cormer in level 7 and 8.

Also changed game installation so that it installs 64-bit Java, if user  have 32-bit Java installed.

notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.notes:
Corrected bug related to toolmode selection. 

Corrected some issues in graphical user interface related to the amount of gummings reached to gate (This correction is now made to levels 1-4, previously it was made to levels 5-16).

notes.title: Game improvement update
notes.notes:
Many improvements have been made and lot of bugs have been corrected in the game. 

For example many improvements have been made to high flat surfaces, hills, levels and graphical user interface.

Lot of bugs have been corrected related to gummings performance.

notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.notes: Corrected bug related to high flat surfaces in level 8 and 15.

notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.notes: Corrected bug related to hill collision in level 2,5 and 11.

notes.title: Level fix update
notes.notes:
Made it easyer to reach gate on high flat surface in level 8 by moving nearest corner further away from gate.  

In addition made it easyer to reach gate on high flat surface in level 15 by moving nearest hill further away from gate.

notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.notes:
Corrected some issues in graphical user interface related to the amount of gummings reached to gate. In this phase these corrections are made from level 5 to level 15.

In addition corrected one issue related to hill in level 7.

notes.title: Bug fix update
notes.notes: Corrected bug related to gate collision detection.
